description: The main window shows the page the engine serves on 127.0.0.1, a remote origin to Tauri. It sets its menus in the macOS menu bar and hears the shell's quit request (core:default holds the core menu and event permissions), closes its own window for File > Exit, and calls the app's own commands: set_window_title, app_ready, text_edit, listen_for_exit and confirm_exit.
